speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; to begin our evaluation of your skin lesions and rule out any oncologic conditions, have you noticed any new growths, changes in existing moles, or bleeding sores?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

Thank you for providing those details; the combination of non-healing, crusty lesions on a high-risk individual with significant smoking history and failed prior treatments is highly concerning for malignancy. Given the location and chronicity, I would like to confirm the pathology immediately. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and digital lesions.
